svg.text: The piece funnels from one forecast into three independent case studies of relationship-only societies that all
land on the same finding, then follows that finding forward into a claim about what paid work actually gives us —
ending in a hedge that loops back to the opening worry.

g.text: One forecast (AI ends work) opens into three unrelated case studies of relationship-only life, which converge on the
same pattern, and that pattern is then carried forward into a claim about work and friendship — with a closing hedge
that loops back to the start.
